tests: CTest 17/17; ASan/UBSan NUPACK tests passed with leak detection disabled
data_source: Existing official archive /tmp/ipknot-dataset.zip; 2022 IPknot, Zenodo 4923158; MD5/SHA256 verified by dataset.py
ambiguous_policy: All non-ACGUT letters map to N and cannot pair. Unknown loop bases have no sequence-specific bonus; unknown small interior loops use generic length/asymmetry energies. Original symbols and coordinates are preserved.
protocol_changes: Early r=1 pilot and interrupted preliminary runs were superseded by user-specified r=0 NUPACK and ambiguous-base fix. No preliminary measurements are included in the final results.
canonical_regression: After ambiguous-base changes: repaired reference and optimized exact log Z / float BPP matched bitwise at lengths 20, 40, 60; independent one-run validation on CPU 0, excluded from benchmark timings.
harness_tests: 5/5 passed, including independent crossing-pair oracle, exact-pair metric check, common-set selection and score-corruption rejection, real subprocess timeout and address-space limit checks.

existing_benchmark_check.condition: DD50 / LPC100 / r=1 / all 816 long sequences

auxiliary_accuracy_phase.source_rule: All <=190 nt: separate accuracy-short/A725 phase; all >190 nt: original final/X925 phase. Rule fixed before auxiliary predictions.
auxiliary_accuracy_phase.settings: Identical frozen binary, posterior and decoder settings, refinement 0 for LinearNUPACK / 1 for LPC and LPV.
auxiliary_accuracy_phase.scope: Accuracy only; no mixed-CPU runtime or memory aggregation. Original final phase remains the performance source.
auxiliary_accuracy_phase.scheduling: Runs concurrently on otherwise idle A725 cores 0-4,10-14. Original final phase is on X925 cores 5-9,15-19.
